entries.name: slide-fold
entries.title: Labelled layers in a whole-slide scan
entries.caption: One fold of the cerebellum in a 3.7 GB slide scan of a young mouse, read as a 1,200 × 900 pixel region. The rulers are file pixels, so an agent can read coordinates off the picture and put its labels where it sees the layers.
commands: openreadout preview zenodo10577621-Young-mouse.czi --region 43300,13300,1200,900 --level 0 --max-size 1400 --annotate '[{"type":"point","x":43504,"y":13570,"label":"Immature granule cells"},{"type":"point","x":43540,"y":13795,"label":"Molecular layer"},{"type":"point","x":43996,"y":13921,"label":"Purkinje cells"},{"type":"point","x":44140,"y":14074,"label":"Granular layer"}]' -o slide-fold.png

entries.name: flow-density
entries.title: Flow cytometry as a density plot
entries.caption: Two fluorescence parameters of an FCS file on asinh axes.
commands: openreadout preview flowkit-8c-e01.fcs --column 'CD4 PE-Cy7 FLR-A' --column 'CD8 PerCP-Cy55 FLR-A' --max-size 900 -o flow-density.png

entries.name: plate-grid
entries.title: 96 growth curves, flagged as they grew or crashed
entries.caption: Blank-subtracted growth in plate positions. A colour rule at 6 h splits the wells into those that grew and those that crashed or held back, and the row and column headings come from the plate layout.
entries.spec:
{
  "title": "Plate 1: growth in every well",
  "data": {
    "file": "softmax5-kinetic-phage-120308b.pda",
    "subtract": "blank",
    "color_by": {
      "at": 6,
      "below": 0.1,
      "label": "crashed or held back",
      "else": "grew"
    }
  },
  "facet": "plate",
  "row_labels": [
    "λ",
    "HK97"
  ],
  "column_labels": [
    "0",
    "0",
    "5",
    "50",
    "500",
    "5k",
    "50k",
    "500k",
    "5M",
    "50M",
    "500M",
    "blank"
  ],
  "caption": "Phage per well. Data: Refardt, Bergmiller & Kümmerli, Dryad, CC0."
}
